Modern Living with kathy ireland®: See Hippocrates Wellness Discuss Their Revolutionary Approach to Better Health and Greater Happiness

Tune in to WE tv as sponsored programming on Thursday, August 10, 2017 and Bloomberg International on Sunday, August 13, 2017. See market-by-market listings below.

Los Angeles, CA – August 8, 2017 – Hippocrates Wellness Co-Directors Anna Maria Clement and Brian Clement will soon appear on the award-winning, global TV show, Modern Living with kathy ireland®. The segment's topic is the institute's mission to help people feel better about themselves and take better care of themselves.

Hippocrates Wellness is one of the most world-renowned health and wellness facilities in the world. Their focus is on helping people live healthier, happier lives. The institute was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida.

Brian Clement says that taking care of one's self is the most important job in the world -- and Hippocrates Wellness knows this. He explains, "It doesn't matter if you're a poor person or a billionaire when you're dying. Everyone always says the same thing to me: 'I wish my priorities were different.' So, at Hippocrates Wellness, what we want to do is get people to make their priority themselves. If you don't take care of yourself, respect yourself and honor yourself, you're going to get sick and suffer. And that's a domino effect. It not only affects you as an individual, but also your family and humanity as a whole. So our greater mission is to help people help themselves."

JL Haber, Vice President of Programming for Modern Living with kathy ireland®, is proud to feature Hippocrates Wellness. He says, “In today's world, everything seems to go a mile a minute. People run from appointment to appointment, meeting to meeting, task to task. But this lifestyle can take a toll on us. Hippocrates Wellness is committed to helping people slow down and come back to what's really important. Because if you aren't taking good care of yourself, how can you really take good care of anything else? We're absolutely thrilled to feature Hippocrates Wellness on our show."

For more information about Hippocrates Wellness, visit HippocratesInst.org and tune in to WE tv as sponsored programming on Thursday, August 10, 2017 at 7:30am EST and Bloomberg International on Sunday, August 13, 2017 at 7:00am GMT, 10:00am D.F. and 2:30pm HKT.

About Modern Living with kathy ireland®

Modern Living with kathy ireland® is a weekly business television program featuring real-world insights from corporate executives from all over the globe.

Modern Living with kathy ireland® airs throughout North America on WE tv as part of their sponsored programming lineup and to over 50 countries throughout the world on Sundays on Bloomberg International as part of their sponsored programming lineup.
